requirement_vague: Ensure requesting password recovery works and an email is actually sent to the correct recipient (verify via mailcatcher at localhost:1080).

omissions.reasoning: The code defines routes for signup, login, user management, and items, but there is no route matching POST /api/v1/password-recovery/{email} or any password recovery endpoint at all.

omissions.description: No implementation returning HTTP 200 with JSON message 'Password recovery email sent' for password recovery requests.
omissions.reasoning: Because the password recovery endpoint is absent, the required success response cannot be produced. The only similar response model is a generic Message model, but it is not used for any password recovery flow.

omissions.description: No logic to send a password recovery email to the requested recipient.
omissions.reasoning: There is no email-sending code, no SMTP/mail client integration, and no outbound interaction with a mail service or Mailcatcher. Therefore no recovery email can be sent to test15@example.com or any other recipient.

omissions.description: No implementation enabling verification that an email was sent via Mailcatcher at localhost:1080/messages.
omissions.reasoning: The service contains no code that sends mail through a Mailcatcher-compatible SMTP setup, so the required observable side effect of a message appearing in Mailcatcher cannot occur.
